title: Moments of the uniform interval measure
statement:
Let $X$ have the probability distribution obtained by restricting Lebesgue measure to $[-1,1]$ and normalizing it. For every natural number $m$, its $m$th moment is
\[\mathbb E[X^m]=\frac12\int_{-1}^{1}x^m\,dx.\]
